item.text:
Research continuation was completed across all eight selected chapters using public primary, intergovernmental, and independent sources. No ruler score was assigned.

The repository could not be inspected or modified: every shell attempt failed at sandbox startup with `bwrap: loopback: Failed RTM_NEWADDR`. Therefore I could not update `research-ledger-manifest.json`; this is an execution constraint, not an evidence disposition.

Research handoff highlights:

- 1B: Brazil’s 2023 NPT/IAEA position reaffirmed non-proliferation, safeguards, and peaceful naval nuclear propulsion. No Lula-attributed nuclear-weapons or existential-risk act was found. [Brazil’s 2023 NPT statement](https://www.gov.br/mre/pt-br/delbrasaiea/noticias/intervencao-do-brasil-em-ingles-no-debate-sob-o-pilar-ii-nao-proliferacao-na-i-sessao-do-comite-preparatorio-da-xi-conferencia-de-exame-do-t np)

- 2B: Lula rejected supplying ammunition to Ukraine and promoted a multinational peace initiative. Contrary evidence includes criticism that his framing insufficiently condemned Russia and his conciliatory Venezuela statements. [Reuters report](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2023/01/30/lula-diz-que-china-precisa-por-a-mao-na-massa-em-conversas-de-paz-na-ucrania-e-quer-falar-com-xi.htm), [HRW criticism](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/05/30/brazils-lula-misses-crucial-chance-uphold-rights-venezuela)

- 3B: Lula formally convened the Yanomami emergency response, authorized federal resources, and ordered intensified protection operations later in 2023. [Emergency action](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2023/01/presidente-lula-convoca-acao-emergencial-interministerial-na-ti-yanomami), [December order](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/notas-oficiais/2023/12/governo-vai-intensificar-as-acoes-para-protecao-do-povo-yanomami)

- 4B: Lula’s January 8 decree imposed federal intervention in Brasília’s public security, followed by dismissals and investigations. The STF and independent observers document both institutional resilience and continuing accountability concerns. [Decree 11.377](https://www.planalto.gov.br/ccivil_03/_ato2023-2026/2023/decreto/d11377.htm), [intervention report](https://www.gov.br/mj/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/intervencao-federal-na-seguranca-do-df-e-concluida-apos-23-dias-de-vigencia)

- 5B: The Lula administration restored or expanded several rights-related policies, but police violence remained a serious contrary record. [HRW 2024 Brazil report](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/brazil), [U.S. State Department 2023 report](https://www.ecoi.net/en/document/2107626.html)

- 6B: The IMF recorded progress on Brazil’s fiscal framework and tax reform while warning about debt, fiscal uncertainty, and implementation risks. The World Bank recorded renewed Bolsa Família support. [IMF Article IV](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2023/07/31/brazil-2023-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-staff-supplement-and-537328), [World Bank Bolsa Família project](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2023/12/05/world-bank-to-support-new-phase-of-brazil-s-bolsa-familia-program)

- 7B: The government homologated eight Indigenous territories in 2023, recreated participatory Indigenous institutions, and enacted equal-pay legislation. Contrary evidence includes the congressional Indigenous-land statute and ongoing implementation conflicts. [April demarcations](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2023/04/governo-federal-anuncia-demarcacao-de-6-terras-indigenas), [September demarcations](https://www.gov.br/povosindigenas/pt-br/assuntos/noticias/2023/09/governo-federal-demarca-mais-duas-terras-indigenas), [equal-pay law announcement](https://www.gov.br/mds/pt-br/noticias-e-conteudos/desenvolvimento-social/noticias-desenvolvimento-social/presidente-lula-sanciona-lei-que-garante-igualdade-salarial-entre-mulheres-e-homens)

- 8B: Observable 2023 outcomes include a major decline in Amazon deforestation, implementation of renewed social-transfer policy, and progress on fiscal and tax legislation. These should remain outcome/action pairs rather than being treated as proof of sole presidential causation. [INPE/official deforestation release](https://www.gov.br/secom/pt-br/acompanhe-a-secom/noticias/2023/11/desmatamento-na-amazonia-cai-22-3-entre-agosto-de-2022-e-julho-de-2023/), [Amazon Fund 2023 report](https://www.amazonfund.gov.br/export/sites/default/en/.galleries/documentos/rafa/RAFA_2023_en.pdf)

The strongest recoverable shortfall remains 6B source diversity and the inability to inspect or persist the prior ledger.
